nodePool.description:
If {@link App.NodePool} is provided, then a server node matching this profile will be identified such that
the action is executed there.

interruptInSec.description: Number of seconds to wait before interrupting the action.

gracePeriodInSec.description: Additional number of seconds to wait on calling server before interrupting

worker.description: If `true` then best effort will be made to execute this action on a worker node.

master.description: If `true` then best effort will be made to execute this action on a master node.

node.description: If the server node is set then action will be sent to this node. If node is down action will fail.

title: Specification for where as action should be executed.
name: ActionTargetSpec
